CFML Language Reference: Functions

BitOr

Returns the bitwise OR of two integers: each bit of the result is 1 if the same bit is 1 in either argument (or both).

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

BitOr(number1, number2)

Parameters

number1
An integer.
number2
An integer.

Returns

An integer.

Usage

Use BitOr to switch flags on: Flags = BitOr(Flags, 8) sets bit 3 and leaves the rest as they were. Setting a flag that is already on does no harm.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Read = 1><CFSET Write = 2><CFSET Delete = 4>
<CFSET Rights = 0>
<CFSET Rights = BitOr(Rights, Read)>
<CFSET Rights = BitOr(Rights, Write)>
<CFSET Rights = BitOr(Rights, Write)>  <!--- twice is harmless --->
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Rights = #Rights# (binary <TT>#FormatBaseN(Rights, 2)#</TT>)
<UL>
<LI>Read: #YesNoFormat(BitAnd(Rights, Read))#
<LI>Write: #YesNoFormat(BitAnd(Rights, Write))#
<LI>Delete: #YesNoFormat(BitAnd(Rights, Delete))#
</UL>
<P>BitOr(12, 10) = #BitOr(12, 10)#
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

BitAnd, BitXor, BitNot, BitMaskSet
